name: Manipulative People
overview: Scripture warns against those who seek to harm others through deceit, as their shame is assured (Psalms 71:24). Wisdom calls for righteous judgment and defense of the vulnerable rather than selfish manipulation (Proverbs 31:9; Proverbs 21:20). Believers are reminded to act sincerely, not for human recognition, but to honor God’s righteous standards (Matthew 6:1), following Christ’s example of humble service rather than self-serving ambition (Mark 10:45). God's impartial care over all people encourages us to reflect His character by rejecting manipulative behavior and pursuing integrity (Matthew 5:45).
